cardinality.rule: setOrientation: a 3D viewport has no setOrientation in 6.0: viewport.setViewState({ viewPlaneNormal, viewUp }), then viewport.resetViewState()
getImageActor: a 3D viewport has no getImageActor in 6.0: viewport.getActors().find((entry) => entry.referencedId === volumeId)?.actor
getNumberOfSlices: a 3D viewport has no slices in 6.0
scroll: a 3D viewport has no slices in 6.0
end: a video viewport has no end in 6.0: viewport.seek(timeSeconds), the start is 0
getNumberOfSlices: an ECG viewport has no getNumberOfSlices in 6.0: an ECG is one record and has no slices
getCanvas: an ECG viewport has no getCanvas in 6.0: viewport.canvas, the same canvas, on which the waveform is drawn
hasImageURI: a video viewport has no hasImageURI in 6.0: viewport.isReferenceViewable({ referencedImageURI }, { withNavigation: true })
getCanvas: a video viewport has no getCanvas in 6.0: viewport.canvas is its canvas, which holds no pixels of the frame, and viewport.getImageData() gives the pixels of the frame
getCanvas: a whole slide viewport has no getCanvas in 6.0: viewport.canvas, the same canvas
